text:
Elan P.: Heads-up — planning a rolling reboot window for apac-edge (apac-west1) due to sustained thermal events on rack cohort C3-C8. Target window Tue 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Sophia (infra): +1, saw temp spikes across those racks in the last 12h. Do we have predicted capacity loss numbers?

Elan P.: Rough estimate: 6 racks (~72 GPUs) offline in wave-of-3-drains with 10m stagger. Expected throughput drop ~18% for apac region, we'll backfill from eu-pools and allow burst to hosted tier.

Dave: Concern — backfilling from eu will add egress and cross-region latency for some tenants. Any customers pinned to apac-only that we need to ping?

Jules: I can run a quick query to find tenants with region pinning and >5k qps. If we need, we should pre-warm KV cache in eu to avoid tail-latency.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: #MT-3142. Notifying oncall rotation and updating infra calendar.

Sophia (infra): Can we stagger drains to keep most critical pools >= 80%? Suggest cohort drain schedule: C3/C4 (02:00-02:30), C5/C6 (02:40-03:10), C7/C8 (03:20-03:50). Backfill in between.

Elan P.: That schedule works. Will set canary (C3) first, validate latencies and error rates for 20m before proceeding. If errors >1% rollback and abort.

Dave: Cost note: cross-region burst will add ~0.25c/token equivalent for the window (rough calc) — finance flagged for any >$2k/day anomalies.

Jules: Running tenant pin query now — results: 4 tenants pinned to apac with high qps (IDs: t-112, t-218, t-909, t-777). Recommend comms to their owners and optional VIP failover.

Sophia (infra): Can someone post the drain command we'll use so SREs can rehearse?

Elan P.: Standard drain snippet (will put in runbook):

```
# cordon + drain (graceful, ignore daemonsets)
kubectl cordon node-<id>
kubectl drain node-<id> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60 --timeout=5m
```

Elan P.: We'll also run a lightweight canary job once nodes are back (kv-seed + perf probe). If canary passes, continue.

Jules: Also add `--pod-selector='app!=critical-stateful'` if we want to avoid touching certain stateful tenants.

Dave: FYI I'll schedule a short notice to t-112/218 owners: asking if they need a manual migration or want us to failover to eu.

Sophia (infra): Ops checklist before canary: confirm BMC firmware is stable on the cohort, ensure nvlink tests pass, create prometheus alert temporarily to catch small latency spikes.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall assigned: @sre-rotation-night. Slack reminder set for 01:45 UTC.

Elan P.: After action items: (1) Jules -> finalize tenant list & comms, (2) Dave -> draft owner notices, (3) Sophia -> add temporary alerts & runbook updates, (4) Me -> orchestrate canary and approve next waves.

Jules: Will send comms draft in ~30m.

Dave: I'll ping finance with cost delta estimate.

Sophia (infra): Leaving a note: if thermal trend doesn't drop by Monday morning, we should convert this to a higher-priority preemptive window and expand cohort.

Elan P.: Copy. Will monitor telemetry and post any changes here. :thumbsup:
